Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental factual error regarding the physical properties of water. It incorrectly asserted that water freezes at 0°C under standard conditions but then claimed that at -5°C, a sample of water "commonly remains liquid due to supercooling." While supercooling is a phenomenon, it is not the standard state of water at -5°C; under normal conditions, water freezes at 0°C and exists as a solid (ice) below that temperature. The Planner's reasoning relied on an unverified and misleading assumption about the "common" state of water at sub-zero temperatures without utilizing the available capabilities (like WebSurfer) to verify basic scientific facts, leading to the selection of the incorrect option (B) instead of the correct one (C).
